name: Weekly Inverse-Vol Portfolio (SPY/TLT/GLD/DBC)
description: Weekly rebalanced inverse-volatility portfolio across SPY, TLT, GLD, and DBC. 200-day SMA trend filter: assets below their SMA are excluded at each weekly rebalance and their allocation redistributes to active assets. Inverse-volatility weighting using 60-day rolling annualized vol with a 5% vol floor to prevent any single asset from dominating. Rebalances on the first trading day of each week.
source:
# Weekly Inverse-Volatility Portfolio: SPY, TLT, GLD, DBC
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Rules:
#   1. Rebalance every Monday (first trading day of week)
#   2. Trend filter: only hold asset if close > 200-day SMA on rebalance day
#   3. Weighting: inverse-volatility using 60-day rolling vol, 5% floor
#   4. Assets failing trend filter → allocation redistributes to active assets
#   5. If ALL assets fail trend filter → fully in cash (no positions)

# --- Data ---
src = market_data_source(timeframe=1D)()
close = src.c

# --- Rebalance Signal ---
# Fire on the first trading day of each week (Monday or next available)
is_new_week = is_period_boundary(period=PeriodType.week)(index())

# --- Trend Filter ---
# 200-day SMA — check on rebalance day only
sma_200 = ma(period=200, type=MAType.sma)(close)
above_sma = close > sma_200

# Gate entry/exit to weekly rebalance dates only
# Enter when: new week AND above SMA
# Exit when:  new week AND below SMA (move to cash)
enter_long = is_new_week and above_sma
exit_long  = is_new_week and not above_sma

# Hold position between rebalance dates (state machine)
held = hold_until()(enter=enter_long, exit=exit_long)

# --- Inverse-Volatility Weighting ---
# 60-day rolling annualized vol (feed close prices directly per S47)
# 5% floor prevents low-vol assets (e.g., TLT in calm regimes) from dominating
vol_60d = volatility(period=60)(close)

# inv_vol_weight: cross-sectional, weights sum to 1.0 across active assets
# Inactive assets (held=False) get weight=0 automatically
weights = inv_vol_weight(min_volatility=0.05)(active_mask=held, volatility=vol_60d)

# --- Execution (wiring order: zone → sizing) ---
# Long-only: enter when held, exit when not held
long_and_short_zone()(long_entry=held)

# Size as % of equity, locked until next weekly rebalance
# weights.weight sums to 1.0 across active assets → multiply by 100 for percent
position_size(type=SizeType.percent)(size=weights.weight * 100, rebalance_on=is_new_week)
